periods.label: 为儿子调来白衣骑士的黑铁家当主
titles: 联盟/魔法骑士机关高层

status.current: present outside Ikki's emergency surgery and arranges Kiriko's intervention

personality.summary: Severe and restrained; in crisis he remains practical and acts through institutional connections.

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Son in mortal danger; Itsuki contacts Kiriko to save him.
relationships.shizuku-kurogane: Daughter; stops her from trying to kill Amane and explains why that would not save Ikki.
relationships.kiriko-yakushi: Contacts her as the doctor capable of handling Ikki's impossible condition.

periods.summary: Itsuki is allowed in the waiting area as Ikki's family during the emergency surgery. When Shizuku declares she will kill Amane to save Ikki, Itsuki orders her to calm down and points out that Amane is unconscious while the death effect continues, so killing him would be pointless. He has already contacted Kiriko, whose arrival gives the family their first real hope.

key_events.summary: Calls Kiriko and restrains Shizuku's desperate revenge impulse.
